CollatzWork.YAH.weightedGapSum_pos: Induct on the certificate list. All weighted terms are nonnegative. If the positive witness is the head, positive natural multiplication and adding a nonnegative tail give strict positivity. Otherwise apply the induction hypothesis to the tail and add the nonnegative head. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L46-L88
CollatzWork.YAH.evalCoefficients_weighte: Induct on the certificate list. The empty certificate evaluates to zero. For a head entry, distribute feature evaluation over coefficient addition and natural scaling, then use the induction hypothesis. These identities follow from integer-module addition and scalar multiplication. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L171-L190
CollatzWork.YAH.unlabelledRows_legal: Evaluate the canonical-word predicate on both sides of each of the thirteen stored instances. The finite Boolean conjunction reduces to true. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L251-L252
CollatzWork.YAH.unlabelledRows_semantic: Evaluate the finite word-value calculations for each stored row and its dynamic-rule flag. Each resulting equality is decidable arithmetic and the complete Boolean check reduces to true. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L254-L255
CollatzWork.YAH.unlabelledCertificate_sh: Compute the two finite list lengths. Both reduce to thirteen. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L257-L259
CollatzWork.YAH.unlabelledCertificate_ca: Evaluate all adjacent-pair count differences and their stored weighted sum on the complete finite enumeration of symbol pairs. The result is the vector with coefficient minus one at ff and zero elsewhere. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L265-L268
CollatzWork.YAH.yah13_forces_ff_negative: The orientation assumptions make every certificate gap nonnegative and make the first, positively weighted dynamic row strictly positive. Hence the weighted gap sum is positive. Linear evaluation of the thirteen-row coefficient cancellation identifies that sum with minus the ff weight, which therefore is negative. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L306-L335
CollatzWork.YAH.ffPumpWord_canonical: Unfold the word construction and canonical-word predicate. Reversal and list replication preserve the repeated f interior, and f is a permitted digit. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L357-L359
CollatzWork.YAH.noBoundedBelowCanonicalF: The thirteen-row orientation implies w(ff)<0. The word potential is w(start,f)+m w(ff)+w(f,end). Cofinality chooses m so that its middle term is smaller than any proposed bound minus the two boundary terms; order-compatible addition then contradicts that bound. The whole-word result uses the proved equality between this expression and the adjacent-edge potential. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L441-L458
CollatzWork.YAH.twoState_rule_equations: Split into the eleven possible rule names and the two Boolean tail values. In each finite case, direct evaluation of the fixed unary maps yields the same Boolean on both sides. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/YAHFiniteObstruction.lean#L464-L468
CollatzWork.YAH.symbolCertificate_shape: Compute the finite list length and the sum obtained by filtering for the dynamic rule flag. Both equal the displayed constants. CollatzWork.YAH.symbolCertificate_canoni: Evaluate the canonical-extension procedure on each stored left and right token list, then evaluate the full-word canonical, terminal-label, and adjacent-label consistency checks. CollatzWork.YAH.symbolCertificate_cancel: Compute the weighted integer left-minus-right feature counts of the stored certificate on the complete finite feature enumeration.
